user.title: Filament Manager
user.description: What do you want to set up?

main.title: Set up Filament Manager
main.description: Boxes, spools and the stock are managed in the dashboard card (add the card "Filament Manager" to a dashboard).

cloud.title: Bambu cloud account
cloud.description: Optional: reads your Bambu filament library (read-only) so spools can follow its remaining amount. If the cloud does not answer, everything keeps working as before. Your password is not stored, only the login token.

cloud_code.title: Verification code
cloud_code.description: Bambu has sent a code to {email}.

cloud_tfa.title: Two-factor code
cloud_tfa.description: Enter the code of your authenticator app.

error.invalid_auth: Login rejected - check e-mail and password.
error.blocked: The Bambu cloud blocked the request. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Bambu cloud.

abort.already_configured: This Bambu account is already connected.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Filament Manager and the Bambu cloud account are already set up.
abort.nothing_to_configure: There is nothing to configure here - boxes and spools are managed in the dashboard card.

consume_filament.name: Consume filament
consume_filament.description: Reduces a spool's remaining weight by the given amount.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount of filament used, in grams.

refill_spool.name: Refill spool
refill_spool.description: Resets a spool's remaining weight, e.g. after mounting a fresh one.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: New remaining weight in grams. If left empty, the spool is reset to its total weight.

load_spool.name: Load spool into printer
load_spool.description: Assigns a spool to an AMS slot of a Bambu Lab printer. The spool that was assigned to this slot before is taken out.

slot.name: AMS slot
slot.description: The tray sensor of the Bambu Lab integration.

unload_spool.name: Take spool out of printer
unload_spool.description: Removes a spool's AMS slot assignment.

move_spool.name: Move spool to another box
move_spool.description: Puts a spool into another box.

open_spool.name: Open sealed spool
open_spool.description: Takes a sealed spool out of the stock and puts it into a box.

add_spool.name: Add spool
add_spool.description: Adds a spool to a box - or, without a box, as a sealed spool to the stock.

box.name: Box
box.description: Box id or its device. Leave empty for the stock.

name.name: Name
name.description: If empty, built from manufacturer, material and color.

total_weight.name: Total weight
total_weight.description: In grams; suggested from material and manufacturer if empty.

remaining_weight.name: Remaining weight
remaining_weight.description: In grams; defaults to the total weight.

notify_targets.name: Notify
notify_targets.description: Notify entities for the low stock warning.

persistent_notification.name: Persistent notification
persistent_notification.description: Show a persistent notification for the low stock warning.

low_stock_threshold.name: Low stock warning below
low_stock_threshold.description: In percent; empty switches it off.

cloud_spool.name: Bambu cloud spool
cloud_spool.description: Id in the cloud library; empty = match by RFID.

remove_spool.name: Remove spool
remove_spool.description: Deletes a spool with its device and entities.

humidity_max.name: Maximum humidity
humidity_max.description: Percent; empty = automatic from the materials inside.

notify_targets.name: Notify
notify_targets.description: Notify entities for the humidity alert.

update_box.name: Edit box
update_box.description: Changes a box's name or settings.

box_not_found.message: The filament box was not found.

box_full.message: The filament box "{box}" is already full.

box_not_empty.message: The filament box "{box}" still holds spools.

limit_below_count.message: "{box}" already holds more spools than that limit.

spool_sealed.message: "{spool}" is sealed - open it into a box first.

slot_unknown.message: "{slot}" is not an AMS slot of the Bambu Lab integration.

remaining_exceeds_total.message: The remaining weight cannot be greater than the total weight.

not_loaded.message: Filament Manager is not set up.
